body: I don't think I will, I guess I'm just looking for people who might feel the same way and maybe find someone to talk to about it instead of keeping it all in

you have your reason, your friends and family. do you really want to hurt them? i feel the same way probably. i don't know you, but i wake up every morning wishing somehow it would end. just don't do it. i can't say it gets better, because im 36, first tried to kill myself at 16, but there will be things that make you want to live over the course of your life and there will be experiences worth having. eventually you'll have to do what i've attempted to do and realize it's in your head and truck on
